name: Towered
description:
About This Game

Defend the Nexus, run after run


Towered is a pixel-art tower defense roguelite about making the right call under pressure. Build a defense before the next wave, adapt when the plan breaks, and carry hard-earned progress into your next attempt.

Build a defense, not a wall


Choose from eighteen towers, each with a job. Archers and cannons bring raw firepower; wizards and lightning rods handle what armor cannot; fountains slow a charge; barracks send your own soldiers into the horde. Windmills and mana pots fund the choices that keep the Nexus alive.

  • Two currencies, two build orders. Gold and mana are earned and spent differently, so every run asks you to prioritize.
  • Population caps how wide you can build. Every tower reserves a slot as soon as you place it. Expand your capacity, or build tall with what you have.
  • Position matters. Range, line of fire, and the shape of the road matter more than simply filling the map.
  • Commit to your towers. Each tower has its own upgrade tree, with exclusive branches that shape how it performs.

Every placement is a decision


A placed tower does not fight immediately. It takes time to finish building, leaving you vulnerable if you rush a wall under pressure. Outgrown a placement? Recycle it for a partial refund and change the plan before the next wave.

Shape the run. Keep the progress.


  • Augments mid-match. Level up and choose one of three upgrades to reshape the current run.
  • A permanent power-up tree. Spend gems earned in matches on nodes that persist across runs: new towers, new starting slots, and new ways to shape each attempt.
  • Quests and a collection book. Unlock and catalogue the towers, enemies, and items you discover.

Three factions. Twenty-one ways to lose the Nexus.


Face dryads, satyrs, pixies, and huntresses from the corrupted forest. Survive goblin hordes with a King at their head. Watch for bandits when the merchant arrives. They come in bands, flow around your towers, and never stop pressing toward the Nexus.

Towered is coming soon. Wishlist the game to get notified when it launches and follow development for new towers, enemies, and updates.
